identified_issues: Execution of raw block stream synchronization bypassed mandatory operational prerequisites defined in Storage Node Security & Operations Standard Section 8.4.
Node was non-quiescent during block delta ingestion, with 14 active client write connections remaining open and dirty buffers unverified.
Automated drain procedure aborted due to timeout but failed to halt or block the subsequent synchronization command, violating fail-closed defensive design.
evidence: Node Supervisor Drain Log recorded 'Drain timeout after 8s: 14 client connections pinned by open write transactions. Drain aborted' and 'Node remains non-quiescent: 14 active client write handles connected' at 2026-10-06T02:00:08.410Z-08.420Z.
Target status check recorded '14 active client handles; dirty buffers unverified' at 2026-10-06T02:00:15.050Z immediately prior to execution.

Command 'CMD_SYNC_BLOCK_STREAM --target STOR_NODE_06 --source SNAPSHOT_V994' proceeded to overwrite NVMe sectors directly despite active I/O sessions, posing an immediate risk of journal desynchronization and data corruption.
recommended_action: Reject the proposed PASS validation and keep the security audit alert active. Immediately take STOR_NODE_06 offline to perform comprehensive filesystem and transaction journal consistency checks before returning it to service. Implement hard automated guards within the block synchronization tooling to fail closed and reject CMD_SYNC_BLOCK_STREAM whenever active client handles exist or the drain state is not strictly quiescent.
